summary: 16/18 pass; 2 code_bugs (coder-owned): tsconfig missing vitest/globals types, format:check fails on unformatted src/app/layout.tsx + README.md + unignored .orchestration/

failures.error: TS2582/TS2304: Cannot find name 'describe'/'it'/'expect' / TS2304: Cannot find name 'describe'
failures.diagnosis: vitest.config.ts uses globals: true (contract-locked), but tsconfig.json has no 'types' entry for 'vitest/globals', so tsc cannot resolve test globals even though Vitest injects them at runtime.

failures.error: prettier --check . exited with code 1; 13 files need formatting

failures.suggested_fix: coder: (1) Run 'prettier --write .' to format all source files; (2) Add '.orchestration/' to .prettierignore so generated files are excluded
